name: process_step_worker_policy
label: Process Step Assignment Policy Table
description: Step allocation strategy table for workflows, used for querying, filtering, and reporting of workflow-related data.

fields.name: process_uuid
fields.description: Workflow UUID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: process_step_uuid
fields.description: The unique identifier for the step, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: policy
fields.description: Strategy, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the process_step_uuid, policy fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_process_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the process_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
